assembly_notes: Five independent component slots (3 x 2 x 3 x 2 x 2 = 72 complete structural combinations) plus one multiplicity N in {1,2,3,4} (raw 288). The root part is `case`; it carries one `lid`, one `closure` and N `powder_pan_i` parts. case_to_lid is REVOLUTE about the real rear hinge line (flip_hinge) or PRISMATIC along the real guide-slot direction (guided_slide); case_to_closure is PRISMATIC along the real wall-pocket axis (push_slide_button) or REVOLUTE about the real front pivot pin (toggle_latch); every powder pan is FIXED on a real seat pocket. Both revolute joints are solved with mate_axes and registered with register_interface_mate; both planar mounts (sliding cover, powder pans) are solved with mate_planes using real supporting footprints. There are no compatibility gates: the closure lives inside a derived front band that is above the tray plate and below the cover plane, which is what lets a guided-slide cover and a push-slide button coexist, and the well pack radius/pitch is solved against the real cavity boundary for every footprint and N, which is what lets the tightest rounded-rect four-well case keep real clearance. No allow_overlap.

candidates.evidence: Axisymmetric stepped case wall, circular floor and rim; the fork asserts a near-circular XY footprint.

parameters.name: case_span_m
parameters.rationale: Overall X span; the wall, cavity, rim, tray, cover plan and every hardware station derive from it.

parameters.name: case_height_m
parameters.rationale: Rim height; floor, cavity depth, cup depth, closure band and skirt drop derive from it.

parameters.name: hy_m
parameters.rationale: Footprint Y half-extent per primary form (hexagon apothem, 80/96 mm rect plan).
parameters.expression: case_span_m / 2 if case_form == 'round' else case_span_m / 2 * cos(pi/6) if case_form == 'hexagonal' else case_span_m / 2 * 0.82

parameters.name: cav_hx_m
parameters.rationale: Real cavity half-extent that the tray, well pack and closure lug must respect.

parameters.name: wall_thk_m

candidates.name: flip_hinge
candidates.evidence: Revolute cover on a rear hinge line with two fixed case knuckles and a central lid barrel plus a peripheral skirt.

parameters.name: lid_open_angle_rad
parameters.rationale: Revolute upper limit; sources sweep 1.68 rad (002) and 1.83 rad (001).

parameters.name: hinge_z_m
parameters.rationale: Puts the axis above every cover point so the whole sweep clears the rim.

parameters.name: hinge_y_m
parameters.rationale: Puts the axis behind the cover's rear edge so knuckles never foul the panel.

parameters.name: skirt_drop_m
parameters.rationale: Skirt depth kept above the closure hardware band.

parameters.name: bore_r_m
parameters.rationale: Real radial clearance between the case pin and the lid barrel bore.

candidates.notes: Case supplies knuckles, a spanning pin and a rear ledge/tower; the skirt is clipped before the ledge so no pose intersects it.

candidates.name: guided_slide
candidates.evidence: Prismatic cover on guide rails replacing the hinge barrels, with a centred lid shell and a slider engaging the rails.

parameters.name: slide_travel_ratio
parameters.rationale: Prismatic upper limit as a fraction of the case Y span; the fork used ~0.39. The band reaches 0.52 so the fully open cover really exposes the powder pack rather than only the front rim.

parameters.name: slide_travel_m
parameters.rationale: Real cover stroke; also sets the guide slot length.

parameters.name: slot_half_w_m
parameters.rationale: Real running clearance between the guide post and the cover slot.

parameters.name: post_x_m
parameters.rationale: Places the posts on the real rim mid-line, never over the cavity.

candidates.notes: Two case posts with retainer heads ride in real elongated cover slots; the cover sits entirely above the rim so the front closure band is free.

candidates.name: lacquer_inlay
candidates.evidence: Recessed lacquer inlay panel on the cover inner face plus eight raised four-lobed clover ornaments on the outer face.

parameters.name: inlay_depth_m
parameters.rationale: Inner-face pocket depth that the inlay panel actually fills.

candidates.notes: No plaque and no mirror; the eight clover motifs give the outer face its own silhouette.

candidates.name: engraved_plaque
candidates.evidence: Herringbone relief field on the cover crown plus a real label recess carrying a contrasting plaque element.

parameters.name: plaque_depth_m
parameters.rationale: Top-face pocket depth the plaque seats into.

candidates.notes: The pocket is cut in the cover crown, not the inner face, so this candidate reads differently from the other two under any motion.

candidates.name: fitted_inner_mirror
candidates.evidence: Fitted mirror pane on the cover inner face, retained inside a surround; the fork asserts the mirror element and material.

parameters.name: mirror_pane_thk_m
parameters.rationale: Pane thickness inside the bezel so the glass never stands proud.

candidates.notes: A bezel ring is generated from the same pocket outline and holds the pane, so the part tree differs from the plain inlay.

candidates.name: push_slide_button
candidates.evidence: Prismatic latch button pressed inward at the front wall over a short ~1.4 mm travel.

parameters.name: button_travel_m
parameters.rationale: Prismatic limit; sources used 0.0014 (002) and 0.0015 (001).

parameters.name: btn_cbore_depth_m
parameters.rationale: Counterbore depth so the cap sinks flush instead of piercing the wall.

parameters.name: closure_z_m
parameters.rationale: Keeps the whole button below the cover plane and above the tray.

candidates.notes: Outer flange, stem through a real wall pocket and an inner retainer lug wider than the pocket: captured in both directions.

candidates.name: toggle_latch
candidates.evidence: Revolute lever with pivot boss, bar, hook and grip on two base mounting lugs with a spanning pivot pin.

parameters.name: latch_lock_angle_rad
parameters.rationale: Revolute upper limit; the fork locked at 1.30 rad.

parameters.name: latch_len_m
parameters.rationale: Lever length so the hook always reaches the active cover edge.

parameters.name: latch_pivot_y_m
parameters.rationale: Stand-off so the lever's whole sweep stays outside the cover.
parameters.expression: lid_front_y_m - latch_gap_m + latch_len_m * cos(latch_lock_angle_rad) - latch_hook_len_m * sin(latch_lock_angle_rad)

parameters.name: latch_bore_r_m
parameters.rationale: Real radial clearance between the case pivot pin and the boss bore.

candidates.notes: The case front wall carries a real pivot recess plus two lugs and a spanning pin, mirroring origin 001's cut housing slot.

candidates.name: round_metal_cup
candidates.evidence: Circular metal cup (floor disc plus annular wall) with a flat pressed cake, retained as a FIXED child of the case.

parameters.name: well_fill_ratio
parameters.rationale: Pressed cake height as a fraction of the cup wall; 002 sat at ~0.90.

parameters.name: well_outer_r_m
parameters.rationale: Cup radius solved against the real cavity boundary for every footprint and N, replacing the fork's fixed constants.
parameters.expression: max over grid pitch of min(cell_limit, cavity_clearance - cav_margin_m)

parameters.name: cake_r_m
parameters.rationale: Cake sits inside the metal wall with real clearance.

candidates.notes: Grid pack 1->1x1, 2->2x1, 3->3x1, 4->2x2 with the pitch maximised against the cavity boundary.

candidates.name: petal_pressed_pan
candidates.evidence: Spline petal profile with the narrow end at the case centre, a recessed petal well and a smaller petal pressed fill.

parameters.name: well_fill_ratio
parameters.rationale: Pressed cake height as a fraction of the petal cup wall.

parameters.name: petal_scale_m
parameters.rationale: Rosette petal size solved from the real cavity inradius; N=1 becomes one centred, enlarged petal pan.
parameters.expression: (cavity_inradius - cav_margin_m) / (petal_mid + petal_half) if well_count > 1 else (cavity_inradius - cav_margin_m) / petal_half

parameters.name: cake_r_m
parameters.rationale: Petal cake shrinks inside its own petal wall.

candidates.notes: N petals at 360/N pitch, each rotated and re-centred on its own outline so the tray opening matches exactly.

multiplicities.name: well_count
multiplicities.spacing_expression: round_metal_cup: grid (cols,rows) = {1:(1,1),2:(2,1),3:(3,1),4:(2,2)} with pitch = 2 * cav_h{x,y}_m * t / {cols,rows}, t chosen to maximise min(pitch/2 - rib_gap, cavity_clearance - cav_margin_m); petal_pressed_pan: rosette pitch 360/well_count deg at radius petal_mid * petal_scale_m (well_count == 1 is centred).
multiplicities.host_capacity_expression: the case tray plate is generated with exactly well_count through-openings matching each pan outline plus well_open_gap_m, so capacity == well_count and every opening keeps cav_margin_m to the cavity wall

derived.name: front_band_hi_m
derived.rationale: Keeps every closure hardware point below the closed cover skirt, so a push button and a flipping skirt never share space.

derived.name: front_band_lo_m
derived.rationale: Keeps the inner retainer lug and pivot boss above the well tray.

derived.name: engage_z_m
derived.rationale: The active cover edge differs per motion, so the latch lever length and the button pocket height derive from it instead of being gated.
derived.expression: case_height_m + 0.5 * panel_thk_m if lid_motion == 'guided_slide' else case_height_m - 0.5 * skirt_drop_m

derived.name: lid_front_y_m
derived.rationale: Cover front outer face that bounds the latch sweep.

derived.name: well_open_gap_m
derived.rationale: Radial gap between each pan and its tray opening.

derived.name: cav_margin_m
derived.rationale: Reserved cavity margin that also clears the closure's inward retainer lug or pivot boss.

derived.name: post_y_m
derived.rationale: Guide post station on the real rim mid-line.

derived.name: slide_travel_m
derived.rationale: Cover stroke that the slot length and the rim support overlap follow.

derived.name: barrel_half_m
derived.rationale: Central lid barrel span; the case knuckles start just outboard of it.

derived.name: knuckle_out_m
derived.rationale: Keeps the knuckles, tower and ledge inside the cover plan.
